cases.description: Realistic two-month demo with 47 entries and three accounts.
checks: Open Home, Entries, Charts and Settings. Shopping is over budget in the demo month.
Balances: local EUR 1,680.22; home INR 170,050.00; cash EUR 143.00. Combined EUR 3,613.22 at the fictional manual rate INR 95 per EUR.
Dates moved to the demo month, but this file can include purchases later than today. Entries and monthly totals include those dates.

cases.description: Clean starting point for entering expenses, income and transfers.
checks: Home: EUR 500 left this month. Settings: bank EUR 1,000; cash EUR 100; combined EUR 1,100.
Home on 21-10-2026: "This week: €250 safe to spend", and "This week: €240 safe to spend" after EUR 10 of Food. The week figure changes with the date.
Quick add demo-snack 6, choose Eating out, then demo-snack 4: second entry remembers the category. Undo within 10 seconds removes only the EUR 4 entry.
Quick add defaults to the EUR bank. Edit the EUR 6 entry to EUR 7.50; exactly one entry remains. Cancel a deletion, then confirm it.

cases.description: Overspending, negative remaining money and saving suggestions.
checks: Home: EUR 60 over this month. Food EUR 50 over; Eating out EUR 40 over; Shopping EUR 40 over; Transport EUR 10 over.
Open the Eating out Try this suggestion: sources and saving explanation appear. Check-in also reviews the overspent categories.

cases.description: All amounts zero; empty charts and no earned badges.
checks: Home shows EUR 0, never NaN or Infinity. Charts explain the empty data. Adding EUR 1 spending is allowed and makes the month EUR 1 over.

cases.description: Negative balances are valid and distinct from the envelope budget.
checks: Settings: bank -EUR 50; cash -EUR 5; combined -EUR 55. Home still has EUR 485 left in envelopes.

cases.description: All seven supported currencies with stable fictional manual rates.
checks: Combined balance EUR 1,680; Home EUR 480 left. Both imported foreign expenses count as EUR 10, even after a rate change.
Add INR 950 through the full expense form: EUR 10 spending at INR 95 per EUR. Manual INR 0 is refused; 100 is accepted and affects future conversions and account totals.
Use ECB rate again only after checking the manual case: live market values are deliberately not fixed expectations.
cases.accountSummary: Demo EUR bank: €1,000.00; Demo cash: €100.00; Demo INR: ₹8,550.00; Demo USD: US$112.50; Demo GBP: £80.00; Demo CHF: CHF 100.00; Demo CNY: CN¥800.00; Demo TRY: TRY 4,000.00

cases.description: Foreign account without any saved rate; test OFFLINE.
checks: Load/cache the production app first. Go offline before restoring this file so a live rate cannot fill the gap.
The account shows INR 9,500. Combined balance shows a dash and names the missing INR rate. A foreign expense cannot save until a rate exists.
Set a manual INR rate of 95 in Settings. Combined balance becomes EUR 100 and INR 95 spending converts to EUR 1.

cases.description: Three occurrences due on the generation date; one paused.
checks: On the demo date, restore then open Entries: Parents EUR 1,200 income, Job EUR 50 income, Rent EUR 450 expense appear with Recurring tags; no Phone entry.
After posting: bank EUR 1,800; cash EUR 100; combined EUR 1,900. Envelope money stays EUR 500.
Reload twice: exactly three entries remain. Settings lets you pause, resume and edit schedules; resuming starts from the next day, without backfilling the pause.

cases.description: Twelve populated months, every spending category, income and transfers.
checks: This month spending EUR 201; income EUR 1,400; saved EUR 1,199. Twelve months: spending EUR 2,412; income EUR 16,800; saved EUR 14,388.
Try Donut/Bars/Table, Columns/Line/Table and 1/3/6/12-month ranges. The donut groups small categories into Everything else.
Tap a category or time column to open matching entries. Everything else has no drill-down. Multi-month category drill-down opens the end month.
The EUR 20 monthly transfers move balances without increasing chart income or spending. Check narrow phone layout and keyboard navigation.

cases.description: 6 recorded under-budget weeks; bronze tier and all four badges.
checks: Badges: Under-Budget Week bronze, Logging Streak earned, Ramen Royalty earned, Latte Survivor earned.
Saved weeks represent historical EUR 100 weekly allowances; changing today's plan does not rewrite those records.

cases.description: 12 recorded under-budget weeks; silver tier and all four badges.
checks: Badges: Under-Budget Week silver, Logging Streak earned, Ramen Royalty earned, Latte Survivor earned.
Saved weeks represent historical EUR 100 weekly allowances; changing today's plan does not rewrite those records.

cases.description: 26 recorded under-budget weeks; gold tier and all four badges.
checks: Badges: Under-Budget Week gold, Logging Streak earned, Ramen Royalty earned, Latte Survivor earned.
Saved weeks represent historical EUR 100 weekly allowances; changing today's plan does not rewrite those records.

cases.description: An earned streak with a recorded away week and a current away mark.
checks: Check-in: I was away this week is selected. Badges: streak is paused; away weeks do not count toward Under-Budget Week or grocery records. Toggle off and reload: the current mark stays off.

cases.description: Accepted empty backup to demonstrate onboarding.
checks: Restore returns to setup, with no plan or accounts. Complete the wizard on a phone-sized screen.
Try blank/zero amounts, invalid text, Back/Next, city cost sources and suggested envelopes. Save a valid plan; reopening setup should not create a second one.

cases.description: Spending before setup affects balances but not the setup month's envelopes.
checks: Home has EUR 480 left. Combined accounts EUR 1,070: both purchases affect balances.
Charts for the demo month count only EUR 20 of grocery spending. On the first of a month, the earlier EUR 10 belongs to the previous month instead.
Check-in lists a pre-setup purchase with an exclusion note when it falls in the displayed week; otherwise find it through Entries.

cases.description: Past, current and future due months.
checks: Edit plan keeps all three costs and remains saveable. Plan summary sets aside EUR 50 this month, leaving EUR 650 available after fixed costs; envelope total remains EUR 500. One-off reserves do not create transactions by themselves.

cases.description: One-cent precision, multilingual text, long notes and literal markup.
checks: Home shows EUR 0.29 left, with cents retained. Bank EUR 999.99. Note displays as text, including the script characters; no alert executes. Edit/reload/export/restore preserve the note. Phone view has no sideways scrolling.

cases.description: Explicit default cash overrides the automatic EUR bank choice.
checks: Quick add demo-default 6 and choose a category. Cash becomes EUR 94; bank stays EUR 1,000. Set bank as default in Settings and add demo-default 4: bank becomes EUR 996; cash stays EUR 94.

cases.description: Profile, semester dates and saved feedback on real catalog IDs.
checks: Home greets Alex Demo. Settings contains the university and both semester dates. Change the name, save and reload.
Tips > Discounts: Asia Restaurant Sunrise is marked Still works; Mensa Uni Regensburg is marked as no longer working and sorted behind working offers. Change feedback, filter a category and reload.
Semester dates allow a next-semester-fee offer in Edit plan. A published amount depends on the bundled semester catalog; do not expect a quote for every future semester.
Profile form refuses reversed or partially filled semester dates. Clear both dates to save without a semester.

cases.description: Every nonzero envelope is spent exactly to its limit.
checks: Home: EUR 0 left this month, with no negative-zero display. Add EUR 0.01 Food spending: the month becomes EUR 0.01 over.

cases.description: A plan with EUR 100 income, EUR 500 fixed and EUR 500 envelopes.
checks: The plan still restores and can be edited. Suggested budget explains that nothing is available and suggests EUR 0 everywhere, so Use this budget is disabled. Type an amount into one envelope, then press Use this budget: only the envelopes change; income, fixed costs, account balances and entries stay as they were.

cases.description: Version 1 compatibility and missing built-in categories.
checks: Restore succeeds; the app supplies all 26 built-in categories. Profile and votes are empty. Export produces a current version 3 backup.

cases.description: Version 2 compatibility and missing built-in categories.
checks: Restore succeeds; the app supplies all 26 built-in categories. Profile and votes are empty. Export produces a current version 3 backup.

cases.description: Unknown object fields are ignored for forward-compatible additions.
checks: Restore succeeds with the same values as 02-clean-budget. Export does not retain unknown fields.
